notes: Nearby QonUS ordering page redirects to webv2.qonus.com.au and resolves to QonUS store code 210813sopoong.
Live QonUS product API checked on 2026-07-07 returned 85 products with nutrition fields present in the schema, but every kJ, calorie, protein, carbohydrate, and fat value was zero or null.

The menu has vegetarian-looking candidates such as Kimchi Pancake, Hot Stone Bibimbap, and Bibimbap Set, but QonUS does not mark vegetarian status reliably for this store and does not provide usable macros.
Several tofu-looking rows include seafood or pork in the product name, so tofu naming is not enough to treat the dish as vegetarian.
Do not import without another source for both calories and protein; estimating Korean pancakes, bibimbap, or tofu stew from generic dish data would be low confidence.
